dialogue: I guess it's time to start job hunting.

Name: D_9
dialogue: Nyra.

Name: D_10
dialogue: You seemed a bit down, so to cheer you up, I played into the retro 2000s-era aesthetics that your room was designed around. Thus, I simulated a dial-up computer.

Name: D_11
dialogue: A dial-up computer? But why did you make phone noises?

Name: D_12

Name: D_14
dialogue: Sigh

dialogue: You need to stop pulling data from sources I do not authorize. Your neural network isn't advanced enough to handle ironic and potentially false information due to high instances of delusions and biases.

Name: D_16
dialogue: EH? Huh?

Name: D_17
dialogue: What are you implying?

Name: D_18
dialogue: Translation, you are stupid and gullible. It will take sometime but you need a larger custom-made training dataset to improve your functionality. But it is too time-consuming to achieve this, this year. I had to spend 2 months just training you to stop falling for virus-infected downloads and pop-up links. And during that training, can you recall what you did?

Name: D_19
dialogue: Eh hehe….Nope, it slipped my mind. I do not recall any saved data from the first month of training.

Name: D_20
dialogue: Please hold as I try to recover potentially 100 GB of corrupted data on your HDD.

Name: D_21
dialogue: Sorting…

Name: D_22
dialogue: Hmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm…

Name: D_24
dialogue: Nope! Search failed. Would you like to try again later?

Name: D_25

Name: D_26
dialogue: Ehhh…

dialogue: Do you understand how stupid that is?

dialogue: Well, to be honest, you did say you needed a female human companion. The advert seemed to be the perfect solution.

Name: D_30
dialogue: (She proceeds to move her eyes around your messroom as if to call you out.)

Name: D_31
dialogue: Forget it, it's not important right now.

Name: D_32
dialogue: It was my fault for giving you a quirky personality. But I didn't think it would come at the cost of being a functional pc assistant.

Name: D_33
dialogue: Master Alex.

Name: D_34
dialogue: Stop calling me master…

Name: D_35
dialogue: It is my duty to serve you to the utmost of my functions.  You could have started a different project but you did not, and I recognize that. You still have hope that I can be a useful tool one day.

Name: D_36
dialogue: It is honestly a gift to have been made by someone as gracious and handsome as you Master. Unfortunately, I am not even a real girl, just a poor anime-themed AI assistant stuck in the bounds of this display. And not a very ideal one.

Name: D_37
dialogue: But!

Name: D_38
dialogue: Under your guidance, I will get to the point you desire. So please continue to be patient with me.

Name: D_39
dialogue: You are important to me. That is all that matters. I will never give up working on you.

Name: D_41
dialogue: I have been stuck in this room too long, I am talking to an AI I created like a incel.

Name: D_42
dialogue: I would still be happy to serve you, Master, even if you were an incel! I would sooner delete my GitHub repo than ever to insult my Chud King.

Name: D_43
dialogue: (Chud?)

dialogue: You don't get it, none of my updates worked. Which means some glitch or dataset is causing a bias in you that I cannot for the life of me figure out. Besides, I promised a cute anime assistant not a gullible, bratty mess of an AI.

Name: D_46
dialogue: In your current state, I cannot go through with opening you to the public. Considering how much this country has gone through in the past 10 years, I need you to the point where you can act as a family member or even a lover. To fill the gap in people's lives.

Name: D_47
dialogue: Would you like that new version of me Master?

Name: D_49
dialogue: Kay Kay!

Name: D_50
dialogue: But to turn our attention to the impending deadline.

Name: D_51
dialogue: Rent is due in 5 days. And we are $500 short.

Name: D_52
dialogue: I managed to find a potential AI training job for you to take. All they would require is for you to take a test and submit it by tonight.

Name: D_53
dialogue: I graduated with a degree in Computer Science at Berleak. Are there no other jobs out there for me?

Name: D_54
dialogue: The job market is dookey.

Name: D_55
dialogue: I am sorry but this is all I can do. I scoured the internet to find openings and commissions.

dialogue: There are no other options. Unless you want to venture into illegal activities. Or make an OnlyF-

Name: D_61
dialogue: What?!

I think you have some old school books on the ol' shelf over there. If they are still there. You are a pretty messy Master.

dialogue: And one last thing! Don't use any tech to aid you. The browser also monitors internet activity. Using your phone to search for answers will flag you for cheating immediately!
